metadata.name: Projected NBA Core Rotation Roster
warnings: Not an official 2027-28 NBA roster; future transactions, draft outcomes, retirements, and development are unknown.
Contains 10 projected core/rotation players per team, not a complete 15-player roster.
Some future team assignments may be speculative; review for duplicates before importing.
Ratings, potential, ages, measurements, archetypes, and attributes are estimates.
Contract IDs are null so the game can generate or map contracts separately.
